findings.evidence: Mathlib `isFredholm_comp_equiv` and `isFredholm_equiv_comp` state `IsFredholm (composition) ↔ IsFredholm f`, so deriving composition Fredholmness from `IsFredholm f` uses `Iff.mpr`; the wording also occurs near the declarations at lines 179 and 202.
findings.fix: Replace “forward direction”/“only that direction” in all three occurrences with “preservation implication” or explicitly state the implication being generalized.
findings.issue: The module text and the `equiv_comp`/`comp_equiv` docstrings call preservation the “forward direction” of Mathlib’s `IsFredholm (composition) ↔ IsFredholm T`; preservation is the reverse (`mpr`) implication.

findings.evidence: Lines 51–56 use `omit [CompleteSpace 𝕜] in` around `index_comp`; the power section retains the module-level completeness assumption.
findings.fix: State that index additivity holds over any `NontriviallyNormedField`, while the subsequent power results require completeness.
findings.issue: The module docstring says index additivity is proved over a complete scalar field, but `index_comp` explicitly omits `[CompleteSpace 𝕜]`, obscuring the theorem’s stronger scope.

summary: The updated documentation inaccurately describes both the logical direction of Mathlib’s equivalences and the scope of index additivity.
